reason: I would take the free six-week test because it costs nothing and needs no IT work, but I would not pay $2,000 a month for a tool I have not seen catch a real shortage in my own data. My team already trusts our open-PO spreadsheet, and a new tool has to earn that trust first.
objection: Whether it reads supplier emails accurately enough to avoid false alarms, and whether my team will spend more time checking its alerts than they save.
would_change_my_mind: A free test on last month's real exports that flags shortages and late-date changes my team missed or caught late, with the ranked list clear enough that my planners act on it without rework.
